name: nevo-specflow
description: Workspace root for Nevo SpecFlow — a spec-driven development framework for AI-assisted software engineering.

scripts.check:quality: pnpm quality:build-prerequisites && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js check && node tools/agents/dist/bin.js check && pnpm version:check-transition
scripts.check: pnpm check:quality && turbo run typecheck && turbo run build && turbo run test
scripts.agents:build: pnpm docs:check && pnpm --filter nevo-repo-agents build && node tools/agents/dist/bin.js build
scripts.agents:check: pnpm docs:check && pnpm --filter nevo-repo-agents build && node tools/agents/dist/bin.js check
scripts.docs:list: pnpm --filter nevo-repo-docs build && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js list
scripts.docs:find: pnpm --filter nevo-repo-docs build && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js find
scripts.docs:get: pnpm --filter nevo-repo-docs build && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js get
scripts.docs:context: pnpm --filter nevo-repo-docs build && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js context
scripts.docs:check: pnpm --filter nevo-repo-docs build && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js check
scripts.docs:adr: pnpm --filter nevo-repo-docs build && node tools/docs/dist/bin.js adr
